verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of an opt-out or data-usage policy specifically preventing customer code/data from being used to train Snyk's AI models (DeepCode AI, Remediation Agent, MCP-based agents). The only related evidence is a general licensing clause granting Snyk broad rights to uploaded content (snyk-comm-13), which if anything raises concern rather than confirming a training opt-out. Since Snyk processes source code via AI features, this axis clearly applies, but no capability or setting addressing AI-training data use is evidenced.
